He played [[college basketball]] for the [[Duke Blue Devils men's basketball|Duke Blue Devils]]. Keels was a consensus five-star [[college recruiting|recruit]] and one of the top [[shooting guard]]s in the 2021 class. ==High school career== Keels played basketball for [[Paul VI Catholic High School]] in [[Chantilly, Virginia]], where he was teammates with his future college teammate [[Jeremy Roach]].{{cite web |last1=Marks |first1=Brendan |title=5-star combo guard Trevor Keels will join friend Jeremy Roach, giving Duke a lethal backcourt |url=https://theathletic.com/2495505/2021/04/02/5-star-combo-guard-trevor-keels-will-join-friend-jeremy-roach-giving-duke-a-lethal-backcourt/ |website=[[The Athletic]] |access-date=June 18, 2021 |date=April 2, 2021}} As a sophomore, he averaged 15.6 points, 3.9 rebounds and 2.3 assists per game, earning [[Washington Catholic Athletic Conference]] (WCAC) Co-Player of the Year honors.{{cite web |last1=Ricardo |first1=Chad |title=Paul VI's Trevor Keels already has accomplished a lot, but his story is just beginning |url=https://www.nbcsports.com/washington/high-school/paul-vis-trevor-keels-already-has-accomplished-lot-his-story-just-beginning |website=[[NBC Sports]] |access-date=June 18, 2021 |date=July 20, 2020}} In his junior season, Keels led Paul VI to the Virginia Independent Schools Athletic Association Division I state title.{{cite web |last1=Errigo |first1=Michael |title=After falling short in WCAC, Paul VI boys take home VISAA title |url=https://www.washingtonpost.com/sports/highschools/after-falling-short-in-wcac-paul-vi-boys-take-home-visaa-title/2020/02/29/44e8c762-5b39-11ea-9b35-def5a027d470_story.html |website=[[The Washington Post]] |access-date=June 18, 2021 |date=February 29, 2020}} As a senior, he averaged 28.7 points, 9.1 rebounds, 7.2 assists and 3.8 steals per game. He was named Virginia [[Gatorade Player of the Year awards|Gatorade Player of the Year]] and was selected to the [[2021 McDonald's All-American Boys Game|McDonald's All-American Game]], [[Jordan Brand Classic]] and [[Nike Hoop Summit]] rosters.{{cite web |last1=Rowe |first1=Adam |title=Duke signee Trevor Keels named Gatorade Virginia Boy's Basketball Player of the Year |url=https://247sports.com/college/duke/Article/trevor-keels-duke-blue-devils-virginia-state-award-gatorade-166106883/ |website=[[247Sports.com|247Sports]] |access-date=June 19, 2021 |date=June 4, 2021}} ===Recruiting=== Keels received his first [[NCAA Division I]] scholarship offer from [[Wake Forest Demon Deacons men's basketball|Wake Forest]], three games into his high school career.{{cite web |last1=Pell |first1=Samantha |title=This freshman’s high school career is three games old, and he already has a college offer |url=https://www.washingtonpost.com/news/recruiting-insider/wp/2017/12/14/this-freshmans-high-school-career-is-three-games-old-and-he-already-has-a-college-offer/ |website=[[The Washington Post]] |access-date=June 19, 2021 |date=December 14, 2017}} He finished as a consensus five-star recruit and one of the top [[shooting guard]]s in the 2021 class. On April 2, 2021, Keels committed to playing college basketball for [[Duke Blue Devils men's basketball|Duke]] over offers from [[Virginia Cavaliers men's basketball|Virginia]], [[Villanova Wildcats men's basketball|Villanova]] and [[Kentucky Wildcats men's basketball|Kentucky]].{{cite web |last1=Biancardi |first1=Paul |last2=Borzello |first2=Jeff |title=Trevor Keels commits to Duke, giving Blue Devils three five-stars in 2021 basketball class |url=https://www.espn.com/mens-college-basketball/story/_/id/31184121/trevor-keels-commits-duke-becoming-blue-devils-third-five-star-commit-2021-class |website=[[ESPN]] |access-date=June 18, 2021 |date=April 2, 2021}} {{College Athlete Recruit Start|40=no|collapse=no|year=2021}} {{College Athlete Recruit Entry | recruit = Trevor Keels | position = [[Shooting guard|SG]] | hometown = [[Clinton, Maryland|Clinton, MD]] | highschool = [[Paul VI Catholic High School|Paul VI Catholic]] (VA) | feet = 6 | inches = 5 | weight = 210 | 40 = | commitdate = April 2, 2021 | scout stars = | rivals stars = 5 | 247 stars = 5 | espn stars = 5 | espn grade = 90 }} {{College Athlete Recruit End | 40 = | year = 2021 | rivals ref title = Duke 2021 Basketball Commitments | scout ref title = | espn ref title = 2021 Duke Blue Devils Recruiting Class | rivals school = duke | scout s = | espn schoolid = 150 | 247 overall = 22 | rivals overall = 22 | espn overall = 23 | accessdate = September 22, 2021 | bball = yes }} ==College career== In his collegiate debut, a 79-71 win against [[Kentucky Wildcats men's basketball|Kentucky]], Keels scored 25 points.{{cite news |title=Coach K wins Garden finale as Duke tops Kentucky 79-71 |url=https://www.espn.com/mens-college-basketball/recap?gameId=401369850 |access-date=November 10, 2021 |work=[[ESPN]] |agency=[[Associated Press]] |date=November 9, 2021}} He averaged 11.5 points, 3.4 rebounds, and 2.7 assists in his first season with Duke. Keels was named to the [[Atlantic Coast Conference|ACC]] All-Rookie Team.{{cite press release|url=https://theacc.com/news/2022/3/6/athlete-awards-acc-unveils-2021-22-mens-basketball-awards.aspx|title=ACC Unveils 2021-22 Men’s Basketball Awards |publisher=[[Atlantic Coast Conference]] |date=March 7, 2022 |accessdate=March 8, 2022}} Following his freshman season, Keels announced his intention to enter the [[2022 NBA draft]].{{cite web |title=Trevor Keels joins Duke teammates in declaring for NBA draft |url=https://www.espn.com/nba/story/_/id/33793753/trevor-keels-joins-duke-teammates-declaring-nba-draft|website=[[ESPN]] |access-date=April 25, 2022 |date=April 24, 2022}} On
